title: The First Mod
description: This Mod adds a new ore called Azurite and a new dimention
body:
This Mod adds a New Ore Called Azurite it is beter than iron but worse than dimond.
This mod also adds a new dimention and a new biome called THE PURPLE BIOME... it also adds 2 new mobs the purple cat and the puple CIKEN.

This mod was made with love and for fun.
